design.purpose: A warm two-colour scarf for one adult, worked flat in single crochet with the photographed chunky yarn and 15 mm hook.

steps.c: Place the green yarn on the work surface.
Place blue yarn, hook and scissors beside it.
Ch 15. Sc in 2nd ch and each across: 14 sc.
Ch 1, turn. Rows 2-10: 14 sc each row.
Leave a 15 cm tail and snip the green yarn.
Join blue. Rows 11-20: ch 1, turn, 14 sc.
Leave a 15 cm tail and snip the blue yarn.
Join green. Rows 21-30: ch 1, turn, 14 sc.
Leave a 15 cm tail and snip the green yarn.
Join blue. Rows 31-40: ch 1, turn, 14 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a 15 cm blue tail; snip yarn.
Weave the green tails into nearby edge stitches.
Weave the blue tails into nearby edge stitches.
